node.title: Weighted owner-pair capacity excludes rank eight from K'=37996 onward
node.closure: exact boundary crossing and monotone binomial-ratio propagation
node.statement: The rank-eight affine-owner alternative in the fixed nine-subset target router cannot occur for any 37996<=K'<=1048576. At K'=37996 the weighted selector demand is 579191514708840299 and the owner-pair cap is 579155144020629315, a gap of 36370688210984. At K'=37995 the cap still exceeds demand by 18174297527234. The exact unrounded demand/cap ratio is a constant times C(m',11)/C(n',11), hence strictly increases with K'. The rank-eight route remains open below this first method crossing.
